plainTranslation: A's love and values meets B's depth and power. The sextile supports them, if you act on it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant work smoothly with your depth, control, and willingness to be exposed. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The challenge is that potential alone is not enough. It can be easy to enjoy the chemistry without fully exploring the deeper emotional work available between you. If both people avoid vulnerability, the relationship may remain pleasant, magnetic, and supportive, but some of its most transformative gifts may stay unopened.
advice: Let the connection deepen at a pace that feels safe. Be honest about desire without turning it into control. The gift of this aspect is not intensity for its own sake. It is the chance to experience love as something that transforms without consuming.
summaryShort: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant work smoothly with your depth, control, and willingness to be exposed.
